newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TRADE DEFICIT RISES TO 1.6 BLN KROONS IN MARCH.
newsitem.headline: TRADE DEFICIT RISES TO 1.6 BLN KROONS IN MARCH.

text.p: Estonia's trade deficit rose to 1.6 billion kroons in March compared to 1.1 billion kroons the month before, the statistics office said on Monday.
Estonia's exports were three billion kroons and imports 4.6 billion kroons in March, it added in a statement.
Exports rose by 7.1 percent and imports by 17.9 percent in March compared to February.
The trade deficit with Russia increased from 61.6 million kroons in January to 373.8 million kroons in March.
Estonia exported to 78 countries and imported from 106 countries, the office said.
The European Union accounted for 51.3 percent and CIS countries for 20.9 percent of total exports.
From total imports, the European Union had 56.2 percent and CIS countries 21.6 percent.
The trade deficit was largest with Finland (573.9 million kroons) and the surplus the largest with Latvia (189.3 million kroons).
